bootstrap.estimand: For each case, candidate time saved percent = 100 * (1 - exp(mean(log(candidate_ns_op / baseline_ns_op)))).
bootstrap.interval: Percentile 95% interval from sorted replicate saved-percent values, with linear interpolation at 2.5% and 97.5% (h=(n-1)*p).
bootstrap.resampling_unit: Paired log ratios within one case; sample 10 pairs with replacement for each replicate.
bootstrap.rng: Python random.Random(23117); random.choices(range(10), k=10) for each replicate, iterated case by case in final_results.per_case order.
bootstrap.scope: A separate interval is calculated for each case; no cross-case bootstrap is used.

change.public_and_fallback_scope: The public coefficient visitor and general coefficient/dequantization fallback remain unchanged. The measured direct route applies only to eligible tracked 2D blocks.
change.summary: Tracked 2D coefficient decoding packs the raw token and clipped neighbor-context value into one level byte. The private built-in reconstruction route can write eligible non-lossless, no-quant-matrix 2D coefficients directly into existing int32 transform scratch, with the quantized fallback preserved. The tracked-path bit update separates its cold refill into an underflow branch so the hot update can inline; the prior bit reader already refilled conditionally.

native_gap_report.boundary: Go NewDecoderFromIVF copies packet payloads in the timed constructor; the C helper wraps preloaded packet slices without copying but still parses IVF records in the timed interval.

round_variation.interpretation: descriptive run-order drift only; samples are clustered and no paired-significance claim is made

scope_and_caveats.allocation: Allocation counts match by case: cold p360=180, cold p720=205, both warm cases=0. B/op has small run-to-run variation and is not claimed as exact byte parity.
scope_and_caveats.inference: Per-case paired results are reported independently. The intervals do not support a general claim across codec content or all decoder workloads. No pooled confidence interval or mixed-workload timing ratio is reported.
scope_and_caveats.measurement_field: Use benchmark-reported ns/op for timing. elapsed_wall_seconds in raw rows is process wall time for ordering/audit only, not the performance outcome.
scope_and_caveats.outliers: All 80 rows in the completed confirmation are retained. The prior ENOSPC attempt is a separate failed run and is excluded wholesale; no rows are pooled between attempts.
scope_and_caveats.sample_contract: Each benchmark sample runs N=15 iterations; each iteration decodes one full 48-frame clip. The 10-pair confirmation has 80 rows across four cases and 40 paired rounds.
scope_and_caveats.workload: Public full-clip decode benchmark on p360_intra_q32 and p720_inter_q32, each 48 frames per operation, one decoder thread, GOMAXPROCS=1, GOGC=100.
scope_and_caveats.native_gap_report: Current public gap snapshot is linked above. It is a clustered comparison, not evidence of a causal change from the older 2.823x snapshot.
